note: College-specific timetable rules. The optimiser obeys them and the independent checker counts every break. strength: must = never broken (where the college's own timetable already keeps it), prefer = avoided, and never more often than the college does. Rule types: see app/rules.py.

rules.text: First-year classes stay exactly where the college has them.
rules.why: First year is taught by several departments at once (workshop and drawing by ME, Applied Sciences, the student's own department), so it can only move with all of them together.

rules.text: Mentoring stays exactly where the college has it.
rules.why: Mentors and their groups plan around these fixed hours.

rules.text: M.Tech, PhD and other programmes (Architecture, BCA, ...) stay exactly where the college has them.
Classes run with other departments (open electives, JPAL, classes in their rooms) stay where they are.
rules.why: Their teachers and rooms belong to other departments, so this department can't move them.

rules.text: Classes taught by another department's teacher stay where they are.
rules.why: That teacher's timetable is planned by their own department.

rules.text: Electives and minor courses of IT, ME, CE, ECE and EE stay where they are.
rules.why: We don't have these departments' elective lists yet, so we can't tell which students share them (for CSE we do).

rules.text: 3rd and 4th-year group classes of IT, ME, CE, ECE and EE stay where they are; whole-section classes may move.
rules.why: In 3rd and 4th year a group number can stand for an elective choice rather than fixed students (as it did in CSE). Without the lists only whole-section classes are safe to move.

rules.text: A teacher's lab for two groups of one class is on two different days (e.g. SC Lab A1 Thursday, A2 Friday).
rules.why: Teachers don't take the same lab twice in one day. Pairs the college itself holds on one day may stay.

rules.text: No class for the whole section after JPAL on that day.
rules.why: Only about 20 of 150 D4 students take JPAL. A class after it would make everyone else wait through JPAL for it.

rules.text: Every weekday has at least one real lecture or lab, not just the open elective, major project, mentoring or JPAL.
rules.why: College rule: students must have proper classes on every working day. (1st-year subjects are taught by Applied Sciences and are not in CSE's timetable.)
